Subject: Your Sigma 18-35 rental deposit

Hi Aoife,

Thanks for returning the Sigma 18-35. I know it's never fun to see a deduction from a deposit, and I'm sorry this is the news after your rental.

When the lens came back, the front element had a scratch on it. We took $160 from your $600 deposit to cover it, because we consider that damage beyond normal wear and tear. I'm happy to send you photos of the scratch if you'd like to see it.

I also want to be fair to you. If you prefer, we can lower the charge to $100 as a goodwill gesture and refund the $60 difference.

How would you like to proceed? Just tell me whether you'd like the photos, the reduced charge, or both, and I'll take care of it.

Best,
[Your name]
